services.name: Liberty Star Day Sail
services.desc: Get a look at beautiful Boston from the water - from the deck of a real tall ship! Duration 1.5 Hours About Come out for a day sail adventure in Boston Harbor aboard our classic schooner, the Liberty Star. Get away from the hustle and bustle of the city streets and enjoy some quality time out on the water with unbeatable views of the city. Drinks are available onboard for purchase via cash, credit, or Apple Pay - our menu includes several beers brewed right here in South Boston! We also have red and white wine, vodka- and rum-based cocktails, soda, juice, and water available in addition to several snack options. Snacks and bag lunches are welcome, but please no coolers or outside beverages.

services.name: Liberty Star Harborfest Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Watch amazing fireworks from the deck of a real tall ship! About Celebrate Harborfest week with a BANG aboard the Liberty Star. We will be out on Boston Harbor from 8:30 to 10:30pm, with fireworks scheduled to begin at 9:15pm. Sit back and relax while you enjoy the amazing view of the celebration with a backdrop of the city lights. Our bar will be fully stocked locally-distilled spirits, Boston craft and national brews, wine, soda, juices, and water. We accept cash, credit cards, or Apple Pay on board. services.name: USS Constitution Turnaround Sail Aboard Liberty Star
services.desc: Celebrate America while sailing on a tall ship and viewing the USS Constitution as she transits Boston Harbor. Duration 2.5 to 3 Hours About Celebrate America's birthday on Historic Boston Harbor with "Old Ironsides"! The USS Constitution will transit to Castle Island and fire a 21-gun salute at exactly 12 noon on the Fourth of July as she stretches her legs for her annual turnaround sail. Come aboard the Liberty Star as we sail alongside the Constitution for a once in a lifetime chance to see the oldest commissioned naval vessel still afloat celebrate our Nation's birth! services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Our two authentic, traditionally-rigged wooden schooners are available to charter in Boston Harbor from May through October, for a minimum of 1.5 hours in the afternoons and 2 hours in the evenings. Guests are welcome to help raise the sails or simply sit back and enjoy the fresh harbor air with unbeatable views of historic Boston. We can accommodate groups of up to 49 guests in addition to our captain and crew. Liberty Fleet is the perfect backdrop for corporate gatherings, teambuilding events, birthday or wedding celebrations, and retirement parties! We have multiple bar packages available including cash/consumption, beer/wine, or full open bar. Our menu features many Boston craft brews
